title: Гипотезы 2 и 4: упоры концов (спроги) и C_L max концевых полос
goal: Наследником PendulumWingStrips в стенде spin_run.gd смоделировать упоры концов (ограничение сверху α 2–3 крайних полос, в т. ч. против доворота billow_shift) и C_L max концевых полос +10/15 %; замерить штопор и выход трёх крыльев по SR-К1 v2 и цену для управляемости (переложение 45→45).

accept.name: sr3-variants
accept.cmd: python3 -I -c "import json,sys; R=json.load(open('tools/research/spin_recovery/out/sr-3/summary.json'))['rows']; V=['game','strips_id','sprog2_a','sprog2_b','sprog3_a','sprog3_b','clmax2_10','clmax2_15','clmax3_10','clmax3_15']; k=lambda r:(r['wing'],r['variant'],r['mode'],round(1/r['dt'])); h={k(r):r for r in R}; miss=[(w,v,m,d) for w in ('sport','laminar','training') for v in V for m in ('release','standard','pull_release') for d in (120,60,30) if (w,v,m,d) not in h]; idb=[x for x in h if x[1]=='game' and (x[0],'strips_id',x[2],x[3]) in h and (h[x]['recovered']!=h[(x[0],'strips_id',x[2],x[3])]['recovered'] or abs(h[x]['spin_yaw_dps']-h[(x[0],'strips_id',x[2],x[3])]['spin_yaw_dps'])>1e-6)]; ok=not miss and not idb; print('sr3 ok' if ok else ('bad',miss[:6],len(miss),idb[:4])); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

accept.name: reversal
accept.cmd: python3 -I -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('tools/research/spin_recovery/out/sr-3/reversal.json')); V=['game','sprog2_a','sprog2_b','sprog3_a','sprog3_b','clmax2_10','clmax2_15','clmax3_10','clmax3_15']; miss=[(w,v) for w in ('sport','laminar','training') for v in V if not isinstance(d.get(w,{}).get(v),(int,float))]; print('rev ok' if not miss else ('bad',miss)); sys.exit(0 if not miss else 1)"
